outcome: agreement between clinical and ultrasound assessments of fetal position
cohort: The study included 215 women in active labor at Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre in Moshi, Tanzania.
finding: Clinical and ultrasound assessments of fetal position showed moderate agreement, with molding and huge caput succedaneum being significantly associated with clinical misdiagnosis.
mod_finding: Misdiagnosed fetal positions were associated with a significantly higher cesarean section rate (38.0% vs 9.0%, p < .001).
